claims: Theorem C: CASC ranking is determined by terminal length mod r; survivor = last mover; determinacy <==> r | Delta
Theorem D: REMO on a Delta=0 board is fully determined by (C, r) via the count recursion
Counterexample: Delta=3 family, r=3: first loser fixed (r|Delta) but REMO survivor is strategy-dependent; CASC stays determined

rules.CASC: stuck player eliminated, board unchanged, next cyclic survivor moves (Theorem C applies to all games)
rules.REMO: stuck player eliminated and their stones removed, next cyclic survivor moves (Theorem D applies when Delta=0)

meta.scope: theorems universal for finite downward-closed placement games; machine checks cover the listed boards only
